items.title: EU approves $7.12 billion for Ukraine’s defense as Kyiv marks 35 years of independence
items.summary: Patriot interceptor deliveries have fallen from 675 in 2023 to 364 last year, with 264 projected for 2026.

items.title: No GPS, no landmarks—how Ukraine’s drones hunt Russian spy drones far out over the Black Sea
items.summary: Winged hunters that outlast copters push Russia's spotter drones farther offshore—and those spotters double as the relays that let crews steer Shahed swarms by hand.
